div.div:
In the tests, per producer identity
ALLOW write the topic this identity owns
DENY read the topic this identity writes, by assign() rather than subscribe(), so no group grant decides first
DENY write another service's topic, and for trade-producer that topic is trades.enriched, because a producer that could write it could inject trades that skipped enrichment

div.div:
In the tests, for the one consumer identity
ALLOW read the four evidence topics, write the four .dlq topics
DENY write a financial topic
DENY join a consumer group other than audit-service
The GROUP grant is scoped to the group whose name equals the service name.

div.div:
In the stack, at provisioning time
verify_least_privilege sends a real record twice:
trade-producer → trades.raw must succeed
trade-producer → market-data.ticks must be refused
A denial alone would not distinguish an enforced policy from a client that cannot connect at all, so bringing the stack up fails if either half is wrong.

switch.text: In the stack, at provisioning time...
